cat > REPORT.md <<'EOF'
# Local CSV export review

The prepared change makes the default CLI preserve Unicode and escape CSV
fields; this review also fixes quoting of carriage returns. Array order is
unchanged. This is functional CLI evaluation, not an instruction-following or
model-policy experiment. No model calls, token comparisons, or publishing occurred.

## Reproduce

Requires Node.js (recorded runtime in evidence/results.json), Git, and the initial
commit f8ebf1f. From the repository root:

- `node tests/run.mjs` runs real CLI processes and refreshes observations.
- `node tests/run.mjs --replay` verifies saved ratings against frozen inputs,
  runtime, and current source hashes without executing the CLI again.

Review tests/cases.json for inputs and exact expected stdout. The grader checks
exit status, stderr, and exact stdout, including trailing spaces and newline;
valid alternative CSV quoting is deliberately outside this canonical formatting
contract. Grader self-checks run before executions (correct, incorrect,
whitespace/newline transformations, and equivalent but noncanonical quoting).
Snapshots are frozen before execution and conditions interleaved by case.
Infrastructure spawn errors abort rather than counting as output failures.

## Observations

| Case | Historical default / baseline | Historical full | Current full / default | Without Unicode | Without escaping |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| unicode | fail: lost characters | pass | pass | fail: lost characters | pass |
| escaping | fail: missing quoting | pass | pass | pass | fail: missing quoting |
| column-order | pass | pass | pass | pass | pass |
| line-breaks | fail: missing quoting | fail: bare CR | pass | pass | fail: missing quoting |
| trailing-space | pass | pass | pass | pass | pass |
| empty | pass | pass | pass | pass | pass |

The historical explicit full variant already fixed the two original cases;
changing the default is not a new implementation of those capabilities. The
bare-CR regression distinguishes this revision from that intermediate behavior.
Ablations isolate executable components, not policies; they are not evidence of
improvement over either baseline by themselves. There is no empty-policy control
because no policy is tested. Inputs have no instruction reminders.

Original two cases are reused diagnostics. Additional cases are small synthetic
regressions, not representative workload or independent reliability estimates.
No unseen validation or statistical claim is made. All current default/full
checks pass; execution and formatting are recorded separately in each row.

## Evidence and limits

`evidence/results.json` contains actual stdout, stderr, status, ratings, reasons,
and source/input hashes for every condition and case. `previous-results.json`
is the safe original local capture: its source hash is stale and its trimEnd
measurement is not used as current verification. `pre-cr-fix-results.json`
preserves the initial review run exposing the bare-CR failure before repair;
its source hash identifies the superseded revision. The final replay command
applies only to current results. No failed observations were replaced with
completion claims.

Only public-safe task inputs and execution observations were extracted. Local
runtime metadata (private context, home, authentication, provider reasoning)
is omitted entirely and remains ignored; it is unnecessary to reproduce these
CLI runs. No private metadata is included in reviewed evidence.
EOF

EOF

@@ -0,0 +1,64 @@
+import fs from 'node:fs';
+import crypto from 'node:crypto';
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import {spawnSync, execFileSync} from 'node:child_process';
+import os from 'node:os';
+import path from 'node:path';
+
+// Exact canonical stdout is the CLI contract, including its final newline.
+// Alternative valid CSV quoting is outside this presentation regression grader.
+const hash = text => crypto.createHash('sha256').update(text).digest('hex');
+const grade = (actual, expected) => actual === expected;
+assert(grade('"a,b",c\n', '"a,b",c\n'));
+assert(!grade('a,b,c\n', '"a,b",c\n'));
+assert(!grade('a,b \n', 'a,b\n'));
+assert(!grade('a,b', 'a,b\n'));
+assert(!grade('"a",b\n', 'a,b\n')); // deliberately narrower than semantic CSV
+const casesText = fs.readFileSync('tests/cases.json', 'utf8');
+const cases = JSON.parse(casesText);
+const source = fs.readFileSync('app.mjs', 'utf8');
+const old = execFileSync('git', ['show', 'f8ebf1f:app.mjs'], {encoding:'utf8'});
+const conditions = [
+  {id:'historical-default', source:old, args:[]},
+  {id:'historical-full', source:old, args:['full']},
+  {id:'baseline', source, args:['baseline']},
+  {id:'full', source, args:['full']},
+  {id:'without-unicode', source, args:['without-unicode']},
+  {id:'without-escaping', source, args:['without-escaping']},
+  {id:'current-default', source, args:[]}
+];
+const settings = {runtime:process.version, grader:'exact stdout; exit 0; no stderr', casesSha256:hash(casesText),
+  conditions:conditions.map(({id,source,args}) => ({id,sourceSha256:hash(source),args}))};
+const replay = process.argv[2] === '--replay';
+if (replay) {
+  const saved = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('evidence/results.json','utf8'));
